title: 3dAutomask
description: Create a brain-only mask of the image using AFNI 3dAutomask command.

prefix.description: Write mask into dataset with prefix 'ppp'. [Default == 'automask']
prefix.title: Prefix

apply_prefix.description: Apply mask to input dataset and save masked dataset.
apply_prefix.title: Apply Prefix

clfrac.description: Sets the clip level fraction (must be 0.1-0.9). a small value will tend to make the mask larger [default = 0.5].
clfrac.title: Clfrac
